desc:
🥚 Adopt Eggs and Raise Pets! 🐾

Hatch mystery eggs and find out which pet is inside!

🐣 Hatch: Every egg holds a surprise, from common pups to super-rare legendary pets.
🍖 Raise: Feed, play with and care for your pets as they grow from babies into adults.
✨ Collect: Fill your pet collection and hunt for rare and shiny variants.
🏡 Show off: Take your pets everywhere and show your friends what you’ve hatched!

🎁 Like the game and join the group for a free reward! New eggs and pets are coming soon.
